fields.label: Title
fields.value: 85 Images by 8 L.A. Artists at Brockman Gallery

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Three-fold marketing piece on neon yellow paper advertising a group exhibition at Brockman Gallery, ""'85 Images by 8 Los Angeles Artists."" The exhibition ran from September 8 to October 5, 1985. The exhibition honored the National Endowment for the Arts, and acknowledged the African American Museum Association. Artists featured included Kathleen Wilson, Melvino Garretti, Varnette Honeywood, Charles Dixon, Richard Wyatt, Stanley Wilson, William Pajaud, and John Outterbridge. Includes map with directions
